// Per-channel animation of a 3D transform: translation, rotation, and scale
// each keyed independently. Rotation keys interpolate by spherical
// interpolation (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_linear_interpolation).
type TransformTrack3D
{
    Translation: AnimationTrack<Vector3D>;
    Rotation: AnimationTrack<Quaternion>;
    Scale: AnimationTrack<Number3>;
}
